subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept a private matrix-js-sdk `cryptoBackend.preprocessToDeviceMessages` wrapper for this Matrix SAS compatibility bug after live proof is supplied?
rationale: The code path is a private dependency hook in an E2EE device-trust flow, so automation cannot safely choose the long-term upgrade and security-boundary risk posture.

options.title: Require Proof, Then Accept Hook
options.body: Do not merge until redacted live Element/Synapse proof shows this branch completes the missing-method SAS flow, then accept the focused wrapper with an upgrade recheck expectation.

options.title: Use Maintainer Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can supply private/live proof or an explicit proof override and own the private-hook upgrade risk.

options.title: Reject Private Hook
options.body: Pause this branch and pursue an upstream matrix-js-sdk or Element compatibility fix instead.

recommendation.title: Require Proof, Then Accept Hook
recommendation.body: Do not merge until redacted live Element/Synapse proof shows this branch completes the missing-method SAS flow, then accept the focused wrapper with an upgrade recheck expectation.
